title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING A CERTAIN PORTION OF THE MUNIC- IPALITY OF BATO, PROVINCE OF CATANDUA- NES, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF SAN MIGUEL.

text.en:
1682
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
The municipality of San Miguel shall begin to exist
only after: (1) the Provincial Treasurer of Catanduanes
shall have certified to the financial capability of the new
municipality to provide at least the minimum compensa-
tion for its officials and employees in accordance with
Republic Act No. 602, otherwise known as the Minimum
Wage Law; (2) the plan of the poblacion shall have
been prepared and approved by all authorities concerned;
(3) the title to all needed public improvement sites in
said poblacion shall have been vested in the Government;
and (4) the mayor, vice-mayor and a majority of the
councilors thereof shall have been appointed and have
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of May, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
